fact: Articles 19 and 20 of the Digital Code (Ordonnance-loi n° 23/010 of 13 March 2023) subject providers of digital services to the State to homologation attesting conformity to the Digital Norms and Standards applicable to the public sector.
title: Livre premier - Titre III, Code du numérique (Ordonnance-loi n° 23/010 du 13 mars 2023)
